new_blockers.fix: Serialise the two paths on the document. In clara._tf_knowledge_firm_evidence, before ARM 1, take `perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('clara.firm_knowledge_evidence:' || new.source_document_id::text, 0))`; take the identical lock on `new.document_id` at the top of clara._tf_document_filing_firm_knowledge. Both are transaction-scoped, both key on the same string, so the second transaction blocks until the first commits and then sees the committed row and refuses by name. Add one cell beside the existing twenty — p654.evidence.race_capture_vs_filing — running the two statements from two barrier-synchronised connections in BOTH arrival orders and asserting exactly one commits, the loser carrying CLR10 firm_scope_client_evidence or document_cited_by_firm_default, no 40P01, and evidenceViolators() = {documents:0, works:0} afterwards. If the orchestrator would rather not pay the lock, say so as a named residual against the invariant sentence in 0205's header ("no LIVE firm-scope knowledge record may cite a document carrying a live client filing"), which as written is stronger than what the guards enforce under concurrency.

new_blockers.what: RATIFICATION ITEM, NOT A DEFECT — the fix worker's own 'one change no finding asked for' (commit ba2c1cfe), independently verified here so the orchestrator can rule with evidence. 0205 §0(8) and §E T.4 now count only `state = 'live'` rows and RAISE NOTICE for superseded/withdrawn revisions that still name a client-bearing source, instead of refusing on every revision. I checked it is internally consistent rather than a relaxation: the retraction hatch deliberately admits a withdrawal carrying the predecessor's pins, so a census over all revisions would be strictly stronger than the wall and would make a withdrawn rule's document permanently unfileable. Verified on the fresh chain: prestate printed clean and tail printed OK with the LIVE-only predicate, and my own probes confirm the guards enforce exactly the LIVE form (W1.file_after_withdrawal_the_named_remedy => ADMITTED once the rule is withdrawn). Both rigs now sit at 0 live violators on both arms, with 11 (55512/clara_654) and 8 (55612/clara_654r) historical notice-only revisions — the NOTICE path is therefore exercised for real, not just written.
